# SabrTime

> SabrTime is a free Islamic companion web app with prayer times, Qibla compass, digital tasbeeh counter, dua library, Islamic calendar, ibadah tracker, and an AI-powered Ilm quiz. No ads, no login required, built for daily Islamic practice.

SabrTime helps Muslims stay consistent with daily worship — salah, dhikr, and dua — through simple, distraction-free tools. All features are free to use and require no account. The project is built and maintained by a single developer, Yunus Khan.

## App

- [Home](https://sabrtime.in/): Prayer times, Qibla compass, digital tasbeeh counter, dua library, Islamic calendar, and ibadah tracker
